GET /healthz.summary: Liveness for a load balancer or uptime check. No auth, no data.

POST /api/auth/request.summary: Send a sign-in code by SMS to a phone number (creates nothing yet).

request.lang: string: ar | en, language of the SMS

response.newUser: boolean: this number has no account yet (the next step then needs a name)
response.devCode: string: the code, ONLY in development

POST /api/auth/verify.summary: Check the SMS code. Starts a session (cookie), or asks for the two-step PIN.

request.name: string: required for a new account

response.needPin: boolean: the account has a PIN; no session yet
response.ticket: string: present with needPin, valid 5 minutes, use it on /api/auth/pin

POST /api/auth/pin.summary: Second step of sign-in: the 6-digit PIN. Starts the session. 5 wrong tries lock it for 15 minutes.

POST /api/auth/pin-forgot.summary: Start the 7-day wait after which the SMS code alone signs in and the PIN is cleared.

response.resetAt: integer: when the wait ends (ms since epoch)

response.name: string
response.has_pin: integer: 1 when two-step verification is on

PATCH /api/me.summary: Change name, language, read receipts, push preview.

POST /api/me/phone/request.summary: Change phone number, step 1: a code goes to the NEW number.

POST /api/me/phone/confirm.summary: Change phone number, step 2: confirm with the code. The account, circles and history stay.

POST /api/me/pin.summary: Turn on or change two-step verification (6-digit PIN). Changing needs the current PIN.

request.current: string: required when a PIN already exists

POST /api/me/pin/remove.summary: Turn two-step verification off (needs the PIN).

GET /api/circles.summary: The chat list: circles, groups and one-to-one chats with last message, unread count and personal settings.

POST /api/circles.summary: Create a family circle (with the agent) or a plain group.

POST /api/direct.summary: Open (or create) a one-to-one chat with a registered person by phone number.

POST /api/circles/join.summary: Join a circle with its invite code.

GET /api/circles/:id.summary: One circle: members (with delivered/read marks), settings, last sequence number.

GET /api/circles/:id/messages.summary: Messages. Sync by sequence (`after_seq`) or by revision (`after_rev`, also returns edits and deletions); pages are oldest-first.

query.after_seq: integer: messages with seq greater than this
query.after_rev: integer: messages whose revision is greater than this

POST /api/circles/:id/messages.summary: Send a text message. Idempotent by `client_msg_id`: a retry returns 200 with the same id.

POST /api/circles/:id/read.summary: Mark messages read up to a sequence number.

PATCH /api/messages/:mid.summary: Edit your own text message (15 minutes).

DELETE /api/messages/:mid.summary: Delete for everyone (member 48 hours, manager 7 days; an opened sealed letter only by its author).

POST /api/messages/:mid/react.summary: React with one of the allowed emoji.

POST /api/circles/:id/attachments.summary: Upload photos, video or documents (multipart). The server decides the type by the bytes.

POST /api/circles/:id/sealed.summary: Write a sealed letter (text, voice, video or photo) opened on a date, an occasion or after the author's death (event and death need the agent on).

GET /api/circles/:id/sealed-envelopes.summary: What the family sees: how many letters are waiting and how far the agent is from concluding, never titles or content.

GET /api/me/memory.summary: The agent's archive across all your family circles, newest first.

GET /api/me/export.summary: Download your data in an open format (zip).

GET /api/circles/:id/book.summary: The yearly family book as a printable page.

GET /api/admin/reports.summary: Reports sent by members, open first. The only place staff see message text (of reported messages); each look is written to the audit log.

GET /api/admin/metrics.summary: Latency percentiles, counters and live connections of THIS node. No content, no names.

POST /api/admin/reports/:id/action.summary: A moderator's decision on a report: dismiss, warn, remove_message, suspend_user, ban, escalate. suspend_user and ban also need the user-moderation permission. Sealed letters cannot be removed by moderation.

request.action: string: dismiss | warn | remove_message | suspend_user | ban | escalate
request.days: integer: for suspend_user; omit for until lifted

POST /api/admin/reports/:id/resolve.summary: Older single action: resolve (dismiss) a report with a note.

GET /api/admin/audit.summary: The audit log of staff actions, newest first. Append-only. Never holds message text or a full phone number.

GET /api/admin/users.summary: Find people. By name, or by the last 4+ digits of a phone number. Numbers are always masked here.

GET /api/admin/users/:id.summary: One person's account facts (no message content). `reveal=1` shows the full number, needs the reveal permission, and is audited.

query.reveal: string: 1 to show the full phone number

POST /api/admin/users/:id/suspend.summary: Suspend a person (sessions end at once; no sign-in, no live connection). With `days` it lifts itself.

GET /api/admin/staff.summary: The people with an admin role.

POST /api/admin/users/:id/role.summary: Give or take a staff role. Owner only. The last owner cannot be removed.

request.role: string | null: owner | moderator | support, or null to remove

GET /api/admin/analytics.summary: Usage without content: 30 daily series (sign-ups, active people, messages, new circles), weekly and monthly users, retention (day 1, 7, 30; only since activity tracking began), sealed-letter counts by status.

GET /api/admin/sms.summary: SMS operations (owner): provider, daily cap and use today, blocked calling codes, and per country (last 14 days) sent, failed, blocked, capped, verified and the completion rate. Only calling codes are stored, never numbers.

POST /api/admin/sms/blocked.summary: Replace the list of blocked country calling codes (owner). Blocked countries get no code. Audited.

request.codes: array: calling codes such as 966, up to 4 digits each

GET /api/admin/flags.summary: Platform switches (owner): signups_open, agent_enabled, sealed_enabled, with their current value and what they do.

POST /api/admin/flags/:name.summary: Turn a platform switch on or off (owner). Audited.

POST /api/circles/:id/albums.summary: Create an album (managers of a family circle): the place for photos and voices kept from an old chat.

GET /api/circles/:id/albums.summary: The circle's albums with, for each, how many photos, voices and videos per year.

POST /api/albums/:aid/items.summary: Add one file to an album (multipart: file, optional thumb, takenAt 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' as in the original chat, sender, w, h). Photos, voice recordings and videos only, judged by their bytes. Sending the same file again returns duplicate:true.

GET /api/albums/:aid/items.summary: Items of an album, oldest first, a page at a time.

query.after: integer: item id to continue after

GET /api/album-items/:id/file.summary: The file of an album item (voices play inline, Range supported); `thumb=1` gives the small preview of a photo or video.

DELETE /api/album-items/:id.summary: Remove one item from its album (managers).

DELETE /api/circles/:id/albums/:aid.summary: Remove a whole album and its files (managers).
